For BOTH candidates, prove or disprove:
THE CLASSIFICATION OF THE OUTPUT-POINTER WRITE
The one write through `_result` is classified as **ABI OUTPUT STORAGE**,
not as host AST graph mutation.  It writes an enum-sized integer into a
caller-provided slot; it transfers no host pointer into PolyC, mutates
no AST node, and touches no arena, map or list.  The PolyC component
never receives the pointer: the adapter keeps it.
NEITHER CANDIDATE REQUIRES AN ARBITRARY AST POINTER OR HOST
ALLOCATION AUTHORITY IN POLYC, so neither is ineligible on that
WHY BOTH CANDIDATES ARE ELIGIBLE BUT ONLY ONE IS SELECTED

this candidate should be migrated FIRST.  The lexicographic ranking
